data_output.description: data.py must retain tab, weekday, user_id, and video_id, remove categorical hour from the encoded feature set, and add exactly two finite float32 columns sin(2π·hour/24) and cos(2π·hour/24). Missing or invalid hours must use a deterministic documented fallback without reading validation labels. Validation rows must remain in original canonical validation order, and encoding must be fit from training data only.

model_input.description: model.py must accept the encoded categorical fields plus the two cyclic numeric hour columns, preserve additive scoring and BCE/Adam training behavior, and return a finite one-dimensional score for every validation row in input order. No ground-truth data may be accessed by the model. The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly row_ids=np.arange(n_valid,dtype=int64) and scores with matching length.
